feeds.title: La Maison Australia » Outdoor
feeds.description: At La Maison, we aspire to everyday beautiful living. Creating stylish and beautiful homes where inspired design meets superb furniture. Begin your journey to beautiful living with La Maison. In the Outdoor blog, you will get more design ideas, useful buying guides, helpful information tips, and introductions for your outdoors.

feeds.title: Curran Home Blog
feeds.description: We stand behind everything we sell - has slowly evolved over the years, emphasizing quality, design, service, and value. Some of our products are designed by, or manufactured exclusively for, Curran; however, we also offer competitive prices on all of the brands that we sell. We focus on inspiring you with the highest quality of curated European and American-made furniture and floor coverings.

feeds.title: Harbour News
feeds.description: Harbour creates furniture with unique design, incredible durability, and a deep sense of culture derived from the harsh climates that Australians call home. All pieces are built to withstand a variety of climates and made with beautiful but durable materials like powder-coated aluminum and mildew-resistant upholstery.

feeds.title: My Wicker Outdoor Furniture Blog
feeds.description: My Wicker is an Australian family-owned business that started in 2009. We sourced trending European-style fabrics and paired them with our own custom-made outdoor wicker settings that we wanted wider, deeper, and more versatile. It's unique and specifically tailored for the Australian market. Get helpful tips and information on caring for your outdoor wicker dining, lounge, and patio settings.
